verdict.rationale: Railway documents unlimited environments and a per-pull-request preview, so changes can be tested outside production. Its MCP server lets AI assistants manage environments, and cloud agents run on separate remote machines, which suits agent-driven sandbox testing. missing for 10: explicit documentation that environment or preview data (e.g. databases, variables) is isolated from production, detail on seeding or cloning sandbox data, independent hands-on corroboration.
